scientific.integrity: The defining Aida projection recurrence is analyzed directly. Signed-angle invariance gives exact scalar norm recurrences; the zero-regularizer limit then yields a closed cosine-power discrepancy law.
limitations: The exact discrepancy multiplier is for the zero-regularizer projection limit.
For positive projection regularizer, exact norm recurrences and cosine-power norm bounds remain valid.
The result controls layerwise total squared discrepancy rather than each coordinate separately.
No full optimization trajectory or convergence-rate claim is made.

title: Aida's projection depth is an exact cosine-power disagreement filter
